cases.name: testSpaceBeforeLineEndComments
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
    lv_value = 0." comment

    ls_pair = VALUE #(" initial comment
                       a = '3.1415'" pi
                       b = '1.4142'" sqrt(2)
                      )." final comment
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
    lv_value = 0. " comment

    ls_pair = VALUE #( " initial comment
                       a = '3.1415' " pi
                       b = '1.4142' " sqrt(2)
                      ). " final comment
  ENDMETHOD.
